coverage_notes.result_summary: CMS Public Notices was accessed first and showed no notice newer than November 2, 2026. Twelve further targeted web searches focused on closures, emergency and rural service loss, EMS/air-medical bases, dialysis, behavioral health, oncology, primary care, essential-service restoration, territories, and CLIA/provider action. No new qualifying nonduplicate healthcare-access development verified.
